app.ai_chat_launches.{key}.executable: Per-conversation launch snapshot, owned by ACP session creation; not a global launch preference (acp_chat::ChatLaunch).
app.ai_chat_launches.{key}.profile: Per-conversation launch snapshot; edit app.ego_profile for the next conversation instead.
app.ai_chat_launches.{key}.workspace: Per-conversation workspace snapshot; existing conversations retain their workspace.
app.attachment_retention_days: Legacy ignored field: the Rust descriptor states uploads have session lifetime regardless of this value.
app.custom_launchers.{id}.id: Read-only stable identity assigned by the launcher editor; changing it would replace record identity.
app.services.auth.session_token: Generated credential; the Remote Access page rotates it through regenerate_session_token, never an arbitrary editable token field.
app.services.push.vapid_private_key: Generated P-256 credential paired with vapid_public_key by push::generate_vapid_keys; no independent private-key editor.
connections.connections.{id}.id: Read-only connection identity; the connection editor creates it and owner removal retires it.
ego.auth.{provider}.credential_command: Read-only credential presence projection; use the AI Chat provider credential-command workflow, never an editable redaction object.
ego.auth.{provider}.headers: Read-only header presence projection; use the AI Chat provider headers workflow, not a redaction-object replacement.
ego.credentials.{key}: Read-only owner credential status; authentication remains in the configured Ego's login flow.
ego.exec_paths: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF's AI engine is built in and does not surface ego configuration.
ego.model: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF's AI engine picks its model on the Providers page, not through ego.
ego.network: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF does not surface ego's sandbox perimeter.
ego.roots: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF does not surface ego's sandbox perimeter.
github_accounts.accounts.{id}.credential: Write-only credential managed by verified cloud-device or enterprise-PAT account workflows in GitHubTab, not a raw transaction.
github_accounts.accounts.{id}.id: Read-only stable account identity owned by GitHub account creation/removal.
github_accounts.auth.source: Read-only runtime credential provenance from the GitHub owner; account/login workflows select the source, not an editable source-kind preference.
keybindings.bindings.{action}.action: Read-only action identity; built-in actions and frontend plugin registrations define it.
pane_layout.root: Structured pane geometry is controlled by the split-pane UI and existing layout owner, not an opaque JSON Settings editor.
preferences.tasks_view_preferences.{key}: Serialized TaskViewPreference envelope owned by Tasks view controls and ui.ts; a free-text field would be an opaque JSON editor.
preferences.detached_panels.{key}: Native detached-window lifecycle mapping owned by setDetached/clearDetached in ui.ts, not a configurable window-label string.
prompts.prompts.{id}.text: Serialized SavedPrompt envelope owned by promptLibrary.ts and the structured Smart Prompts editor; plain-text replacement would destroy the prompt record.
prompts.prompts.{id}.id: Read-only prompt identity; the structured Smart Prompts editor owns creation/removal.
repositories.repos.{key}.path: Read-only registered repository identity; registration changes do not rename or delete filesystem paths.
repositories_registration.groups.{id}.id: Read-only group identity assigned by the Appearance group editor.
repositories_registration.repos.{path}.p: Read-only repository identity; registration is a separate owner workflow.
tunnels.profiles.{id}.id: Read-only tunnel identity assigned by the tunnel editor.
upstreams.servers.{id}.credentials.auth: Write-only bearer/OAuth presence; the upstream editor uses typed credential owner actions rather than a raw transaction.
upstreams.servers.{id}.headers.{name}.cr: Internal vault reference; the upstream header credential workflow owns allocation and cleanup.
upstreams.servers.{id}.id: Read-only server identity assigned by upstream creation.
github_accounts.accounts.{id}.kind: Account kind is derived by the verified GitHubTab cloud/enterprise owner workflow, not independently mutable configuration.
github_bindings.bindings.{key}.account_i: GitHubTab repository binding selector uses the typed bind owner workflow; no file-store transaction adapter is registered.
github_bindings.bindings.{key}.owner: Canonical repository owner comes from the registered repository binding workflow, not an independent free-text owner patch.
github_bindings.bindings.{key}.repo: Canonical repository name comes from the registered repository binding workflow, not an independent free-text repo patch.
github_accounts.accounts.{id}.host.host: GitHubTab Enterprise host entry belongs to the verified account creation workflow; the account owner intentionally has no raw file-store transaction adapter.
github_bindings.bindings.{key}.remote_na: GitHubTab binding selector uses the typed repository-binding owner workflow, not a raw field transaction.
voice.speech_edge_voice: Retired Microsoft Edge voice: FastAF never sends reply text to Microsoft, so there is no voice to pick; Rust keeps the field only so older config files round-trip.
agents.agents.{key}.ego_mode: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF does not surface ego launch modes.
agents.agents.{key}.ego_sandbox: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF does not surface ego's sandbox settings.
app.ego_executable: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF's AI engine is built in and does not surface ego configuration.
app.ego_profile: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF does not surface ego profiles.
repo_local.ego_profile: ego is upstream's external ACP agent; FastAF does not surface per-repository ego profiles.
